qe:
Error Spotting: Select the part that contains an error:
'Scarcely had the (A) / function started (B) / than the power (C) / went out (D).'
qh:
त्रुटि पहचानें: उस भाग का चयन करें जिसमें त्रुटि है:
'Scarcely had the (A) / function started (B) / than the power (C) / went out (D).'
e: Rule: The correlative conjunction pair for 'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The situation in the flood-affected areas is ______ and requires immediate intervention from the authorities.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The situation in the flood-affected areas is ______ and requires immediate intervention from the authorities.'
e: Vocabulary: 'Precarious' means dangerously likely to fall or collapse; uncertain. 'Placid' means calm, which doesn't fit the context of a disaster.

qe: Direct/Indirect: He said, 'If I were a king, I would help all the poor people.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: He said, 'If I were a king, I would help all the poor people.'
o: He told that he would help poor people
He expressed a wish that if he were a king he would help all the poor people
He said that if he had been a king
He said that if he was a king he would help
e: Rule: In Subjunctive/Hypothetical sentences, 'were' remains 'were' in indirect speech to preserve the imaginary sense.

qe: Active/Passive: 'The committee is considering the proposal very carefully.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'The committee is considering the proposal very carefully.'
o: The proposal is being considered very carefully by the committee
The proposal has been considered by the committee
e: Rule: Present Continuous passive: 'is/am/are + being + V3'.

qe: One Word Substitution: 'A government run by a small group of people for their own interests.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'स्वयं के हितों के लिए लोगों के एक छोटे समूह द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली सरकार।'
e: Vocabulary: Oligarchy (अल्पतंत्र) is the term for government by a small group. Autocracy is by one person.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'The students have been studying in this school since five years.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'The students have been studying in this school since five years.'
e: Rule: Use 'for' for a period/duration of time (five years). 'Since' is used for a point of time.

qe: Synonym: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: 'RECALCITRANT'
qh: समानार्थी: 'RECALCITRANT' का सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची चुनें।
e: Meaning: Recalcitrant means having an uncooperative attitude toward authority. Obstinate (जिद्दी/हठी) is its synonym.

qe: Antonym: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: 'LOQUACIOUS'
qh: विलोम: 'LOQUACIOUS' का सबसे उपयुक्त विपरीतार्थक चुनें।
e: Meaning: Loquacious means talkative. Reticent (अल्पभाषी) means not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily.

qe: Idiom: 'To keep one's head above water.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To keep one's head above water.'
o: To swim for a long time
e: Meaning: To manage to survive financially or avoid failure during a difficult time.

qe: Error Spotting: 'Not only the (A) / principal but (B) / the teachers (C) / was present (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Not only the (A) / principal but (B) / the teachers (C) / was present (D).'
e: Rule: When subjects are joined by 'Not only...but also', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. 'The teachers' is plural, so it should be 'were'.

qe: Active/Passive: 'They are playing a match.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'They are playing a match.'
o: A match is being played by them
e: Rule: Present continuous adds 'being' in passive.

qe: Vocabulary: Select the word with the correct spelling.
qh: वर्तनी: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनें।
e: Spelling: Questionnaire has a double 'n'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He is ______ to the environment of this place.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He is ______ to the environment of this place.'
e: Grammar: 'Accustomed to' is a standard phrase meaning used to or in the habit of.

qe: Idiom: 'To burn the candle at both ends.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To burn the candle at both ends.'
e: Meaning: To exhaust oneself by working too hard or doing too many things.

qe: Error Spotting: 'The furniture (A) / in this room (B) / are very (C) / expensive (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The furniture (A) / in this room (B) / are very (C) / expensive (D).'
e: Rule: 'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb ('is').

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'FRUGAL'.
qh: विलोम: 'FRUGAL' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: Frugal means economical. Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च) is the opposite.

qe: One Word: 'A person who is recoverning from an illness.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'वह जो बीमारी से उबर रहा हो।'
e: Vocabulary: Convalescent is the correct term for recovery.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'I prefer tea than coffee.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'I prefer tea than coffee.'
e: Rule: 'Prefer' takes the preposition 'to'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the East.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the East.'
o: The teacher said that the sun rose in the East
The teacher told the sun rises
The teacher said that the sun rises in the East
e: Rule: No change in tense for Universal Truths.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'Neither of the students ______ present.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Neither of the students ______ present.'
e: Rule: 'Neither of' always takes a singular verb.

qe: Active/Passive: 'Who wrote this book?'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'Who wrote this book?'
o: By whom was this book written?
By whom this book was written?
e: Rule: 'Who' changes to 'By whom'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'CANDID'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'CANDID' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Candid means honest and straightforward or Frank.

qe: Error Spotting: 'If I was you (A) / I would not (B) / accept the (C) / offer (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'If I was you (A) / I would not (B) / accept the (C) / offer (D).'
e: Rule: In hypothetical conditions, use 'were' with all subjects.

qe: Idiom: 'To bite the dust.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To bite the dust.'
e: Meaning: To fail or be defeated.

qe: Vocabulary: Correct spelling of 'Maintenance'.
qh: वर्तनी: सही शब्द चुनें।
e: Spelling: Maintenance is correct (often misspelled as Maintainance).

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'ARROGANT'.
qh: विलोम: 'ARROGANT' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: Arrogant means proud. Humble (विनम्र) is the opposite.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He is senior ______ me.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He is senior ______ me.'
e: Rule: Adjectives like Senior, Junior, Superior take 'to'.

qe: One Word Substitution: 'The study of ancient societies.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'प्राचीन समाजों का अध्ययन।'
e: Vocabulary: Archaeology is the study of human history through excavation.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'No sooner had I reached the station when the train left.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'No sooner had I reached the station when the train left.'
e: Rule: 'No sooner' is always paired with 'than'.

qe: Error Spotting: 'The news (A) / of his death (B) / were (C) / shocking (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The news (A) / of his death (B) / were (C) / shocking (D).'
e: Rule: 'News' is singular and takes a singular verb ('was').

qe: Direct/Indirect: He said to me, 'What are you doing?'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: He said to me, 'What are you doing?'
o: He asked me what was I doing
He told me what am I doing
He asked me what I was doing
e: Rule: Assertive word order (Subject + Verb) in indirect questions.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He is ______ M.A. in History.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He is ______ M.A. in History.'
e: Article: Use 'an' before 'M.A.' because it starts with a vowel sound ('Em').

qe: Idiom: 'At the eleventh hour.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'At the eleventh hour.'
e: Meaning: Doing something at the very last possible moment.

qe: Active/Passive: 'Open the door.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'Open the door.'
e: Rule: Imperative passive: 'Let + object + be + V3'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'ABUNDANT'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'ABUNDANT' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Abundant means existing in large quantities or Plentiful.
